theater: 納伊蘇斯城北的赫庫勒斯營地

battle.name: 納伊蘇斯戰役
battle.theater: 納伊蘇斯城北的赫庫勒斯營地
battle.brief: 公元二六八年春，羅馬皇帝加里安努斯在上莫西亞迎擊越過多瑙河的哥特聯軍，交戰地點在納伊蘇斯城北古稱「赫庫勒斯營」的駐軍地。羅馬步兵以盾牆與標槍正面吸住敵軍主力，騎兵自兩翼反轉包抄，哥特王赫魯利被生擒，聯軍崩潰退回河北。埃及長矛則留在族裔輔助步兵手中，以成排矛牆守住營寨缺口。

kit.name: 埃及長矛
kit.history: 早王朝時期的長矛，銅或青銅矛頭綁在木杆上。埃及人用它守城垣，後來也用它收復失地。

countries: 納伊蘇斯戰役是公元二六八年春，羅馬皇帝加里安努斯在上莫西亞迎擊越過多瑙河北上的哥特人與赫魯利人聯軍的一役。羅馬一方以皇帝本人為最高統帥，戰場部隊由多瑙河前線各軍團抽調，骨幹是駐防上莫西亞與下莫西亞的步兵軍團，加上以伊利里亞與色雷斯補充兵源組成的編年營，以及禁衛騎兵與各支附屬騎兵隊；軍需由多瑙河下游的西米里烏姆、維米納西烏姆等基地沿河與谷地道路向前沿輸送，軍隊每日按營地規格挖塹築寨。皇帝身邊有禁衛軍與軍法官系統負責傳令、賞罰與戰俘看管，戰鬥序列上步兵居中擔任正面，騎兵分置兩翼與後方預備隊。對面並非國家軍隊，而是以哥特部族為骨幹、吸納赫魯利與蓋皮德等部落的聯盟，首領為史籍記載的哥特王赫魯利，率部眾越過多瑙河進入莫西亞與色雷斯，以掠奪城市、穀倉與牧場為主要目標，並以大量騎兵作為突擊與脫離的主力；聯軍內部沒有固定編制與統一指揮，戰敗或盟主被擒往往令其迅速瓦解。當時羅馬帝國本身四分五裂：萊茵一帶存在高盧帝國，莫西亞與色雷斯因連年戰亂與前線崩潰而空虛，這正是聯軍得以長驅直入的結構性原因。
countriesEn: The Battle of Naissus was fought in the spring of AD 268, when the Roman emperor Gallienus met in Upper Moesia a confederation of Goths and Heruli who had crossed the Danube from the north. On the Roman side the emperor himself was supreme commander. The field force was drawn from the legions holding the Danubian frontier; its backbone was the infantry legions stationed in Upper and Lower Moesia, together with the annual cohorts raised from Illyrian and Thracian recruits, the imperial guard cavalry and the auxiliary horse. Supply was carried forward from the bases in Lower Moesia, at Sirmium and Viminacium, along the river and the valley roads, and the army dug its marching camp to the standard camp rule each day. Around the emperor worked the praetorian guard and the military legal system, responsible for signals, discipline and the custody of prisoners. In the order of battle the infantry held the centre and the cavalry stood on the wings and in the reserve. The enemy was not a state army at all but a coalition built around the Gothic tribes and drawing in the Heruli and the Gepids, led by the Gothic king Heruli as the sources record him. The confederation crossed the Danube into Moesia and Thrace with plunder as its main purpose, taking towns, granaries and pastures, and relied on large numbers of mounted warriors both to strike and to break contact. It had no fixed establishment and no unified command, and a defeat or the capture of its leader would normally dissolve it at once. The Roman state itself was divided at the time: a Gallic Empire stood on the Rhine, and Moesia and Thrace lay hollow after a decade of war and the collapse of the frontier. That structural weakness was precisely what had allowed the confederation to drive so far into the provinces in the first place.
people: 皇帝加里安努斯是本役的核心人物。他出身比利亞的利基尼烏斯家族，父瓦勒良於二六〇年在東方前線被波斯沙普俘獲，加里安努斯隨即在萊茵與多瑙河各線獨力支撐，經歷二六〇年代高盧帝國分裂與卡勞狄烏斯二世重新統一帝國的曲折，至二六八年春已是全帝國唯一皇帝。作戰時他親自統兵，把禁衛軍貼身護衛，習慣在陣線附近指揮，並在戰後於羅馬舉行對蠻族的戰勝儀式，被俘的哥特王赫魯利被押在行列之中示眾，蠻族財寶同時被展示。哥特方面的首領名為赫魯利，這個名字出自《皇帝傳略》；不少研究者認為這是部族名被當作人名記錄，或與其他哥特王名號混淆，其本名與在聯軍中的實際權力都難以確定。聯軍內另有各部族首領與千夫長級人物，戰後多數一同被俘。留下這場戰役文字記錄者有《皇帝傳略》的作者、奧勒留斯·維克托與《凱撒傳略節錄》，十二世紀的左納拉斯亦加以轉述；此外加里安努斯在戰後所發的凱旋類錢幣，其上被縛蠻族首領的形象，是後人唯一能看見這場戰役樣貌的物質記錄。加里安努斯本人於同年稍後在米蘭遇刺身亡，年份有二百六十八與二百六十九兩說；他的兒子凱撒薩洛努斯則已在同年稍早的米蘭戰役中對抗奧勒奧盧斯時陣亡。
peopleEn: The central figure in the battle was the emperor Gallienus. He came from the Licinian family of Bithynia; his father Valerian was taken prisoner by the Persian shah on the eastern front in AD 260, after which Gallienus held the Rhine and Danube lines on his own, through the division of the empire into a Gallic Empire during the 260s and the reunification under Claudius II, so that by the spring of 268 he was the sole emperor of the whole empire. In the field he commanded in person, keeping the praetorian guard close about him and accustomed to directing the action from near the line, and afterwards he held a triumph over the barbarians in Rome, where the captured Gothic king Heruli was led in the procession and displayed, together with the barbarian treasure. The leader on the Gothic side is named Heruli, and the name comes from the Historia Augusta; many scholars hold that a tribal name has been recorded as a personal name, or that it is confused with the names of other Gothic kings, so that his real name and his actual authority within the confederation are both uncertain. The confederation also contained the chiefs of the individual tribes and officers of the thousand, most of whom were captured along with the king. The written record of the battle comes from the author of the Historia Augusta, from Aurelius Victor and from the Epitome de Caesaribus, with Zonaras repeating it in the twelfth century; in addition the triumph-type coinage Gallienus struck after the victory, showing a bound barbarian chieftain, is the only material record through which later generations can see what the battle looked like. Gallienus himself was killed by an assassin at Milan a few months after the battle, the year being given variously as 268 and 269; his son the Caesar Salonus had already fallen in the Milan fighting against Aureolus earlier in the same year.
kits: 卡面這支埃及長矛，是青銅矛頭以繩索綁在木杆上的古老長矛，長約兩公尺，柄部常纏皮繩防滑；新王國壁畫中它屬於前排矛手的裝備，用途是以低垂的矛尖截馬腿、割斷挽具，迫使敵方車陣停滯。三世紀中葉的羅馬軍中，這類長矛已不是主力兵器：帝國步兵的核心是長柄標槍、短劍與匕首，盾牌是曲面大盾，鎧甲則由早已淘汰的分段鎧甲改為鎖子甲與鱗甲。真正還保留這種長矛傳統的，是帝國的族裔輔助步兵；埃及籍與敘利亞籍的輔助軍團仍配大盾與長矛，軍籍名錄中可見埃及營與埃及騎兵隊，自征服時期以來他們的傳統武裝長期留在多瑙河前線，本役中這類單位最可能以成排長矛守住營寨缺口，抵擋聯軍輕騎反覆衝擊。哥特與赫魯利步兵多備小圓盾或橢圓盾，盾面蒙皮、綴鐵飾，武器是矛與劍，富庶者穿鎖子甲或鱗甲，並大量使用標槍；其騎兵以同一套裝備為基礎，配更長的刺槍與小盾，衝鋒時靠速度而非正面撞擊。羅馬騎兵此時已改用脊盔、橢圓盾、長刺劍與長矛，戰馬由卡帕多細亞與色雷斯的馬場補充，鞍具與韁繩形制和哥特人相去無幾。攻城器械在本役中全無使用，雙方打的是野戰；羅馬方面只隨軍攜帶築寨器材、帳幕、牛車車隊與備用武器。本役最關鍵的裝備其實是營養與錢幣：多瑙河船隊運來穀物、葡萄酒與飼料，軍中以粗磨穀餅與醃肉維生，賞賜與軍餉則靠新鑄的凱旋類錢幣支付。
kitsEn: The Egyptian spear on this card is an ancient long spear with a bronze head bound to a wooden shaft by cord, about two metres long, the grip often wrapped in hide to stop it slipping. In the New Kingdom paintings it belongs to the equipment of the front-rank spearmen, and its purpose was to lower the point into the legs of horses and cut the traces so as to stop an enemy wagon formation dead. In the mid third century such long spears were no longer the main arm of the Roman army: the core of the imperial infantry was the heavy javelin, the gladius and the dagger, the shield was the curved scutum, and armour had moved away from the long-abandoned segmentata to mail and scale. What still carried that spear tradition were the ethnic auxiliary infantry; Egyptian and Syrian auxiliary cohorts kept the large shield and the long spear, and unit lists show Egyptian cohorts and Egyptian cavalry, whose traditional armament had stood on the Danubian frontier since the days of conquest. In this campaign such units are the most likely to have held the breach of the camp with a wall of spears against the repeated probing of the confederation's light horse. Gothic and Herulian infantry carried small round or oval shields faced in hide and studded with iron, armed with spear and sword, the richer among them in mail or scale, and using the javelin in quantity; their cavalry stood on the same equipment, with a longer thrusting spear and a small shield, relying on speed rather than weight of impact in the charge. Roman cavalry by this time had moved to the ridge helmet, the oval shield, the long spatha and the lance, with remounts drawn from the studs of Cappadocia and Thrace, and saddle and bridle gear not unlike that of the Goths. Siege engines were not used at all in this battle; it was a field engagement, and the Romans simply carried the tools for throwing up the camp, tents, ox-cart trains and spare weapons. The equipment that mattered most in the campaign was in fact rations and money: the Danube fleet brought up grain, wine and fodder, the army subsisted on coarse meal cakes and salted meat, and the donatives and pay were paid out of newly struck triumph-type coinage.
tactics: 本役屬會戰而非攻城，戰場在納伊蘇斯城以北、尼沙瓦河與多瑙河之間開闊的丘陵地，交戰地點古記為「赫庫勒斯營」，是羅馬邊防體系中的一處駐軍地。羅馬軍由行軍縱隊展開：步兵在中央列成密集而略帶弧形的盾牆，前排重裝標槍手在接觸前把標槍齊射，靠槍杆的重量壓彎對方小盾並干擾其步幅，待隊形出現空隙即以短劍接戰；兩翼由騎兵遮蔽，敵方若以大量騎兵衝擊翼側，羅馬騎兵即以反衝與縱深預備隊兜住缺口。哥特聯軍的典型打法是先以散兵與輕騎反覆挑釁消耗羅馬陣線，再投入主力步騎作一次總衝，或避開正面轉而襲擊側翼與糧道，使羅馬無法一次接戰。納伊蘇斯之勝的關鍵，在於羅馬沒有讓聯軍取得戰術主動：正面以盾牆吸住第一波衝擊，騎兵在敵陣疲憊時由兩翼向內反轉包抄，同時以預備步兵封住潰退方向，聯盟首領在合圍中被生擒，此舉令其餘部眾失去號令而各自散去，羅馬追擊至多瑙河岸，奪得馬匹、武器與大批俘虜。營寨隨後成為看管俘虜、整備馬匹與清點戰利的所在，勝方的紀律與供給同樣決定追擊能持續多久。
tacticsEn: This was a pitched battle and not a siege. The ground lay north of Naissus, on the open hills between the Naissava and the Danube, and the place of contact was known in antiquity as the Camp of Hercules, one of the stations of the Roman frontier system. The Roman army deployed out of column: the infantry was drawn up in the centre in a dense, slightly curved wall of shields, and the front rank of heavy javelin men threw their javelins together on contact, relying on the weight of the shaft to bow the enemy's small shields and to disorder his step, closing with the sword as soon as a gap opened in the enemy order. The wings were covered by cavalry, and when the enemy threw masses of horse against a flank the Roman horse answered with a counter-charge and with the reserve in depth plugged the gap. The usual Gothic method was to wear down the Roman line with scattered fighting and light horse, then to commit the main body of foot and horse in one general assault, or to avoid the front altogether and strike the flank and the supply line so that the Romans could not bring everything to bear at once. The key to the victory at Naissus was that the Romans never surrendered the tactical initiative: the front absorbed the first impact against the shield wall, the cavalry reversed inward from both wings once the enemy formation had tired, and reserve infantry closed the ways of retreat; the confederate chief was taken alive in the encirclement, and the rest of the host, deprived of any commander, scattered, the Romans pursuing them to the banks of the Danube and seizing horses, weapons and a great number of prisoners. The camp then served as the place where prisoners were guarded, horses were remustered and booty was counted, and the discipline and supply of the victorious army equally determined how long the pursuit could last.
data: 關於本役的數字，古典文獻留下得極少。年代上加里安努斯於二五三年即位，《皇帝傳略》把這場哥特戰爭繫於其在位第六年，按當時紀年換算正落在公元二六八年；史書未記月份，現代考證多置於該年春夏之交，本卡月份取四月，僅標示戰役開始的時令。兵員方面，兩軍確切人數皆無保存：三世紀越過多瑙河的部族聯軍通常以數萬計的戰士投入，其中騎兵比例偏高；羅馬方面是前線數支軍團與補充營組成的野戰軍，量級同樣在數萬人上下。史家沒有留下雙方的傷亡數，只有大批俘虜與戰利被帶回羅馬的概括記載。距離與補給線上，納伊蘇斯距下莫西亞首府西米里烏姆沿多瑙河谷約兩百公里，羅馬軍隊由這些基地逐步北上，路上依賴船隊與牛車，遠離基地的距離使羅馬無法長期滯留在前線。錢幣方面，加里安努斯在戰後發行多枚凱旋類幣種，圖案為皇帝執矛站立、一名被縛的蠻族首領跪於其前，此類銀幣與貴金屬紀念章是本役在物質層面最直接的可核實記錄；戰後的凱旋式典禮在羅馬舉行，被俘的哥特王與其財寶同場展示。
dataEn: On numbers, the classical record preserves very little. As to date, Gallienus took the throne in AD 253, and the Historia Augusta attaches this Gothic war to the sixth year of his reign, which by the reckoning then in use falls exactly in AD 268; the sources give no month, and modern work generally places the campaign in late spring of that year. The month carried on this card is April, offered only as an indication of the season in which the campaign opened. As to strength, no exact figures survive for either army: tribal confederations crossing the Danube in the third century are usually assessed as committing tens of thousands of warriors, with a high proportion of them mounted, while the Roman side was a field army of several legions with supporting cohorts on the frontier, of the same order of magnitude. The historians left no casualty figures at all, only a general statement that a great many prisoners and much booty were carried back to Rome. As to distance and the supply line, Naissus lies about two hundred kilometres from Sirmium, the capital of Lower Moesia, up the Danube valley; the Roman army moved north from those bases step by step, depending on the river fleet and on ox carts, and the distance from its bases meant the Romans could not stay on the frontier indefinitely. As to coinage, Gallienus struck a number of triumph-type issues after the battle, showing the emperor standing with a spear while a bound barbarian chieftain kneels before him; these silver pieces and the gold and silver medallions are the most directly verifiable material trace of the engagement. The triumph itself was held at Rome, where the captive Gothic king and his treasure were displayed together.
cause: 打起來的原因有遠有近。遠因是三世紀上半葉羅馬多瑙河防線的崩解：多伊馬尼與赫爾蒙杜里等部族相繼滅亡，哥特人與赫魯利人乘勢南移，帝國邊軍在二五〇至二六〇年代連遭挫敗，莫西亞與色雷斯的城鎮、礦區與穀倉暴露在襲擾之下，邊防部隊被抽往東方應付波斯戰事，多瑙河一線只剩薄弱的守備。近因是二六八年的政治危機：瓦勒良被俘後羅馬帝國一度分裂為東西兩半，高盧帝國在萊茵一帶自立，直到卡勞狄烏斯二世在二六八年重新統一；但同年西邊奧勒奧盧斯起兵，帕提亞方向的奧勒安努斯與雷加利安努斯先後自立，加里安努斯只能在米蘭勉強平叛，其子薩洛努斯正是在那一戰中陣亡。聯軍趁羅馬主力被牽制之際越過多瑙河，掃掠莫西亞城鎮；加里安努斯別無選擇，必須立即率軍東進，否則行省與糧道盡失，剛剛重新統一的帝國又會分崩。聯軍本身並無吞併羅馬的計畫，其目標是財物、聲望與俘虜，一旦受阻便退回多瑙河以北，因此對加里安努斯而言，速戰速決、以一次決定性的會戰了結此事，正是最合算的應對。
causeEn: The reasons for the war are both long in reach and immediate. In the distance lies the collapse of the Roman Danubian line in the first half of the third century: tribes such as the Deimani and the Hermunduri were destroyed one after another, the Goths and the Heruli moved south into the gap, and the frontier army suffered repeated defeats between AD 250 and 260, so that the towns, the mining districts and the granaries of Moesia and Thrace lay exposed to raiding while troops were drawn eastward to meet the Persians, leaving only a thin screen on the Danube. Immediately behind it lies the political crisis of 268: after Valerian's capture the empire had split in two, a Gallic Empire had set itself up on the Rhine, and only in 268 had Claudius II reunified the Roman world; but in that same year Aureolus revolted in the west and Ingenuus and Regalianus rose in the Pannonian and Transalpine provinces, so that Gallienus had first to fight out the rising at Milan, where his son Salonus was killed. The confederation crossed the Danube while the Roman main force was tied up there, sweeping the towns of Moesia; Gallienus had no choice but to march east at once, for if the provinces and the supply route were lost the newly reunified empire would fall apart again. The confederation itself had no plan to hold Roman territory: its object was booty, prestige and captives, and once checked it withdrew north of the Danube. It follows that a quick decision, fought out in a single pitched battle, was the cheapest answer open to the emperor.
impact: 納伊蘇斯之勝的實際效果是把哥特聯盟推回多瑙河以北，救下莫西亞與色雷斯的行省與城鎮，恢復帝國前線的運作，使加里安努斯得以在同年冬天重新部署、把注意力轉向帕提亞方向的挑戰，又在次年西邊奧勒安努斯與雷加利安努斯相繼起兵時不至於腹背受敵。政治上，這是羅馬城在漫長的分裂與內亂之後少數明確的對外大勝，凱旋儀式與紀念幣把赫魯利王的形象鑄進帝國的錢幣與公共記憶裡，讓加里安努斯在生命最後的時間裡維持了皇帝威望。軍事上，此役所倚賴的正是他在位期間推行的軍制：把野戰軍固定為由邊軍與常備軍構成、由禁衛騎兵與補充營填補的多瑙河集群，輔助軍與族裔營保留自己的傳統武裝，形成以軍團骨幹、輔助兵與騎兵為主力的混合編制；這套編制在往後二十年被戴克里先與君士坦丁延用，成為四世紀羅馬軍隊能應付多瑙河與萊茵雙線壓力的基礎。長遠看，納伊蘇斯只是把哥特人的壓力推後，並未解決問題：公元二七〇年代起，哥特人再度越過多瑙河並深入多瑙河行省，二七一年與三二二年、三三二至三三五年先後與皇帝和凱撒交戰，最終在三七六年哥特人大批渡過多瑙河，五五三年後的半個世紀裡東歐與巴爾干成為舊羅馬世界崩解的舞台，而納伊蘇斯這場勝仗，正是那條漫長軌跡上最早的里程碑之一。
impactEn: The practical effect of the victory at Naissus was to push the Gothic confederation back north of the Danube, to save the provinces and towns of Moesia and Thrace, and to restore the working of the frontier, so that Gallienus could redeploy during the winter of 268, turn his attention to the challenge from the Persian side, and not face the revolts of Ingenuus and Regalianus in the west the following year with enemies behind and before him at once. Politically it was one of the few unambiguous external victories the city of Rome had known through a long age of division and civil war; the triumph and the commemorative coinage fixed the image of the captive king Heruli in the coinage and the public memory of the empire, and allowed Gallienus to keep up the appearance of imperial prestige in the last months of his life. Militarily the victory rested precisely on the organisation he had built up during his reign: the field army regularised into Danubian clusters made of frontier troops and regulars, topped up by the guard cavalry and by recruiting cohorts, while auxiliary and ethnic units kept their own traditional armament, producing a mixed establishment built on the legion and supported by auxiliaries and horse. That establishment was carried on for the next twenty years by Diocletian and Constantine and became the base on which fourth-century Roman armies met pressure on the Danube and the Rhine at the same time. In the long run, though, Naissus only deferred the Gothic question rather than settling it. From the 270s the Goths crossed the Danube again and pushed deep into the Danubian provinces; there were fresh clashes in 271, in 322 and between 332 and 335, and the great crossing of the Danube came in 376, after which the collapse of the old Roman world in the Balkans and the east unfolded across half a century from 553 onwards. The victory at Naissus stands as the first milestone on that long road.
result: 結果是羅馬方面的完勝。哥特王赫魯利被生擒，連同大批部族首領與部眾一同被押往羅馬，於凱旋式上示眾，蠻族首領與其財寶同時成為慶祝對象；聯軍主力在會戰中被擊潰，殘部退回多瑙河以北，掠去的物資大半被奪回，莫西亞與色雷斯的城鎮與農地免於進一步洗劫。羅馬軍隊的損失不詳，但沒有任何一位行省總督或主要統帥陣亡的記載；可以確認的重大傷亡是加里安努斯的兒子凱撒薩洛努斯在同年稍早的米蘭戰役中陣亡，以及皇帝本人在戰役之後數月於米蘭遇刺身亡。加里安努斯一死，二六九年才建立的四帝共治體系旋即取代他的個人統治，新秩序之下，像納伊蘇斯這樣的邊境勝利很快成了帝國無法長期享用的奢侈品。從長期看，這場戰役的收穫不是領土，而是一段寶貴的喘息：多瑙河前線得以重建，羅馬人第一次以完整建制正面擊敗越過多瑙河的大規模部族聯軍並擒獲其首，這份經驗後來在四世紀被用來對付再度渡河的哥特人，只是同一條防線上的考驗很快重來。
resultEn: The result was a complete Roman victory. The Gothic king Heruli was taken alive and carried to Rome with a great many tribal chiefs and with the host itself, and was displayed in the triumph, the barbarian king and his treasure together forming the object of the celebration. The main body of the confederation was broken in the battle, the survivors withdrew north of the Danube, and most of what had been plundered was recovered, so that the towns and fields of Moesia and Thrace escaped further sack. Roman losses are not recorded, and no provincial governor or chief commander is known to have fallen; the two grave losses that are confirmed are the death of Gallienus's son the Caesar Salonus in the Milan fighting earlier the same year, and the emperor's own assassination at Milan a few months after the battle. With Gallienus dead, the tetrarchy established in 268 replaced his personal rule, and under the new order a frontier victory of the Naissus kind soon became a luxury the empire could not enjoy for long. In the long run the campaign yielded no territory but a valuable breathing space: the Danube line was rebuilt, and for the first time the Romans had beaten a large trans-Danubian tribal confederation in a set-piece battle with a fully organised army and taken its chief captive. That experience was used again in the fourth century against Goths who crossed the river once more, though the testing of the same line came back soon enough.
